_readme.workflow: Maa Durga Jan Seva Kendra — Dynamic WhatsApp Bot v3.0.0
_readme.description: Fetches services dynamically from Express backend. No hardcoded service IDs.

variables_required.PUBLIC_APP_URL: Your deployed app URL e.g. https://your-app.onrender.com
variables_required.WHATSAPP_PHONE_NUMBER_ID: From Meta Developer Dashboard > WhatsApp > API Setup

import_steps: 1. Open n8n → New Workflow → Import from File → upload this JSON
3. Create HTTP Header Auth credential: Authorization: Bearer <WHATSAPP_ACCESS_TOKEN>
5. Copy webhook URL from 'WhatsApp Webhook' node
6. In Meta Dashboard: Webhooks → Callback URL = <webhook_url>
